entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. D. Sarkar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr.
Kohinoor N. Bhattacharyya, learned G.A. assisted by Mr. K. De, learned Addl. G.A. appearing for the respondents-State.

By means of filing the present petition the petitioner has prayed for referring the L.A. Case No.40/B/2016 to the court of learned Land Acquisition Tribunal under Section 64 of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.
It is the case of the petitioner that his land was acquired by the Government for construction of railway track from Agartala to Sabroom by NF Railway.
The award was made on 23.02.2016 and the parties including the petitioner were directed to receive the awarded amount on 17.05.2016.
The petitioner on that day could not submit objection.
Thereafter, on 08.07.2016, the petitioner submitted an objection with a prayer to make reference of the matter before the learned Land Acquisition Tribunal, but it was not referred to.
The petitioner approached the Collector on several occasions for making reference, but did not yield any result.

sentences.text: Hence this writ petition before this Court.

On bare perusal of Section 64 of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013, it comes to light that under proviso of sub-Section 2 of Section 64 of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013, learned LA Collector can refer the matter even after stipulated period for filing an application for reference on consideration of the sufficient grounds.
In the instant case, the petitioner belongs to unwary class of public and he does not have any idea about the procedures.
It is settled principle of law that procedure is the hand made of justice, but it cannot deprive the natural right of a citizen.
Moreso, RFCTLARR Act of 2013 is a social welfare legislature.
The object of the said Act is to provide appropriate and adequate compensation to the land losers.
I have perused the petition.
I find there are sufficient grounds to file an application for reference.

Having observed thus and keeping in mind the settled principle of law, I direct the LA Collector to refer L.A. Case No.40/B/2016 to the learned Land Acquisition Tribunal within a period of 3(three)
weeks from today.
With the aforesaid direction, the instant petition stands allowed and thus disposed of.
JUDGE SANJAY byGHOSH GHOSH
